description: Backup mirror of mVolt+, the NVIDIA GPU tuning and monitoring tool with voltage, clock, power and fan control, V/F curves, live telemetry and saved profiles.
notes: Same files as 'mvolt', downloaded from the AmirulAndalib/mvolt-scoop backup mirror instead of the upstream release. Install mvolt or mvolt-mirror, not both.
Tuning needs administrator rights. Profiles and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\mVolt+ and are kept on update and uninstall.
If you opened mVolt+ from its Scoop shortcut, exit it from the tray before updating. A copy started by Start with Windows is updated for you after one administrator prompt.
post_install: $copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'mVolt+.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf })
# Compare against the FileVersion inside the new exe, not the manifest version, so a tag that
# differs from the embedded version can never cause a prompt on every install.
# Runs elevated. Embedded into post_install by Update-Manifests.ps1 and passed with
# -EncodedCommand, so there is no script file a non-admin process could change.

$copies = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'mVolt+.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Leaf })
# Stage the new exe inside the admin-only folder and check it there, so a file swapped
# in the user-writable Scoop folder can never end up as the startup copy.
Out-Log "WARN|The new mVolt+ exe did not match the expected hash. The Start with Windows copy ($old) was left as it is."
Out-Log "OK|Updated the Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ from $old to $Version."
Out-Log "WARN|Could not update the Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ ($old): $($_.Exception.Message)"
Out-Log 'OK|Restarted mVolt+ from its Start with Windows task.'
Out-Log 'WARN|mVolt+ was stopped to update it, but its Start with Windows task was not found. Start mVolt+ again.'
warn "Your Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ is out of date. Open mVolt+ as administrator once to update it to $version."
Write-Host 'Your Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ is out of date. Approve the administrator prompt to update it.'

$job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { param($exe, $a) try { $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $a -Verb RunAs -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -ErrorAction Stop; $p.WaitForExit(); 'ran' } catch { 'declined' } } -ArgumentList $hostExe, $helperArgs

if ($state -ne 'ran') { warn "The administrator prompt was not approved ($state). Your Start with Windows copy of mVolt+ was left as it is. Open mVolt+ as administrator once to update it to $version." }
pre_uninstall: catch { $hr = if ($_.Exception.InnerException) { $_.Exception.InnerException.HResult } else { $_.Exception.HResult }; $busy = $hr -in @(-2147024864, -2147024863); if (-not $busy) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 }
if ($busy) { throw 'mVolt+ is still running from this Scoop install. It may be running as administrator, which Scoop cannot detect. Exit it from the tray icon, then run the command again.' }

warn 'mVolt+ Start with Windows is set up for this user. It runs its own copy from %ProgramFiles%\mVolt+ and keeps starting at logon after this uninstall. Turn Start with Windows off in mVolt+ if you no longer want it.'
